question: Is this the right reading of your view of alpha: several values were possible, the universe landed on one (perhaps through those early initial conditions), and from then on that one value governs every record?
recorded_as: ALLOW: a range of alpha values is possible. The universe landed on one, possibly through early initial conditions (SELECT may be historical, not a native selection rule). REQUIRE: from then on, that one value governs every record in our universe.
